gauge_witness.canonical_remap_procedure: lexicographic ascending by score value (lowest->alpha, middle->beta, highest->gamma)

known_gap: The engine target's beta score (0.225) is depressed by build artifacts. The glob engine/ocaml/**/*.ml walks into the _build/ directory, including generated and compiled files in the corpus. This inflates the cross_reference_consistency penalty (5/5 links unresolved) and the authority_alignment signal (23 authority-claim files, many in _build/). A corrected target excluding _build/ would score higher on beta.
notes: Mechanical mode: c_sigma_mechanical is arithmetic mean (alpha+beta+gamma)/3. C_sigma_math/num use the geometric mean from coherence.ml. L_link values are null — pairwise delta values are not computed in mechanical mode. W2 gauge witness is trivially 0 because the geometric mean C_Sigma^math is S3-symmetric by construction.
